reasons.text: About 53% of this county's corn follows corn. Here corn and soybean are a small share of the cropland, so rotations aren't compared.
This county's corn tends to yield about 28 bu/ac below its state's trend (its soil and how it is farmed, 2009–2023).
In years with excess rain from April to September, corn yields here tend to be about 9 bu/ac lower.

range_driver.text: What moves this county's corn range the most is spring wetness: from about -4 bu/ac in 2022 to about +5 bu/ac in 2018.
